podcast.title: Britpop Party Attendee
podcast.body: Men's Wear was listed among the bands that were part of the Britpop scene and received coverage during its peak. "Here's a list of some of the people at the Britpop party. ...Men's Wear..."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Similar to Oasis
podcast.body: Menswear was among the bands that started to appear, sounding similar to Oasis, demonstrating the latter's popularity and influence within the Britpop scene. "The Oasis approach proved to be so popular that they started to hear and see similar bands."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of Alt Rock: Chapter 12
